title: Your turn
text: This is where somebody has filled something in and is waiting for you.
badge: {count, plural, =1 {One thing is waiting for you} other {# things are waiting for you}}

kinds.contact_request: Somebody would like to get to know you. The contact request is waiting for your answer.
kinds.problem_interest: Somebody would work on your problem with you.
kinds.approach_interest: Somebody is interested in your approach.
kinds.discovery_intro_request: Somebody would like to be introduced to you.
kinds.discovery_intro_accepted: Your introduction request was accepted. You can write to each other now.
kinds.read_my_mind_handoff: Read My Mind: the other side has answered. Your turn.
kinds.founder_in_the_wild_handoff: Founder in the Wild: the other side has filled it in. Your turn.
kinds.collaboration_conversation_marker: The other side would like to talk about a particular point.
kinds.program_update_due: The next update for your program is coming up.
kinds.program_invited: {org} has invited your team to its program. Your team is only in once everyone has agreed.
kinds.program_review_requested: An advisor in your program is asking your team for a team review. You decide under Account whether to agree – nothing happens without everyone's consent.
kinds.program_removed: The organization removed your team from the program. The organization's access has ended and the program data is deleted.
kinds.program_reward_unlocked: Your team has unlocked a reward. Take a look under Program.
kinds.org_task_assigned: You were given a task in the team space.
kinds.org_task_comment: New comment on a task in the team space.
kinds.org_task_due: One of your tasks in the team space is due today.
kinds.advisor_org_invited: You were invited to become a member of an organization. You decide under Invitations whether to accept.
kinds.advisor_person_invited: An advisor asks for insight into parts of your profile. You decide under Invitations – accepting only means the request reaches you.
kinds.founder_invited: A co-founder has invited you. You decide on your dashboard.
kinds.program_task_assigned: A task in the program was assigned to you. Check the shared task list.
kinds.program_task_comment: New comment on a task in the program.

announcements.later: You can find it again later under Messages.

quiet.title: Off hours
quiet.text: During these times your phone stays silent. Messages, tasks and notices still arrive and wait in the app – someone working at 10 pm can write to you without bothering you.
quiet.windowHint: Every day – may cross midnight, e.g. 18:00 to 08:00.
quiet.always: Applies to all notifications on your device, not to emails. Nothing is sent later: what arrives in that time you see the next time you open the app.
quiet.invalid: Please check the times: start and end must not be the same.
quiet.quietNow: Off hours right now – your phone stays silent.
quiet.pausedUntil: Off hours until {time} – your phone stays silent.
quiet.pauseUntilMorning: Off hours now until 8 am tomorrow
